sources.name: KANJIDIC2/JMdict-derived metadata and supplementary vocabulary
sources.attribution: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG). Metadata via existing committed Bunki sources and scriptin/jmdict-simplified. Editorial level tags remain identified by their individual source.

sources.name: Pinned KANJIDIC2 English metadata
sources.attribution: KANJIDIC2 — EDRDG; JSON conversion by scriptin/jmdict-simplified.

policy.membership: All attested levels; distinct entries within each collection. Conflicts repeat across levels.
policy.displayPrecedence: Dictionary reading/meanings first, graded words fallback. Kanji metadata first, committed metadata fallback.
policy.identity: Exact printed form and reading identify vocabulary; never normalize or merge homographs. Missing Unicode glyphs use their source entry ID.
policy.scope: Complete indexed committed corpus, not official or exam-complete lists. Kentei collections are assigned-grade bins, not cumulative test scope.
policy.jlptKanji: Bundled editorial JLPT tags retained verbatim; N3 has no tagged kanji. Historical pre-2010 KANJIDIC levels are not mapped to modern JLPT levels.
policy.unknown: No attested label, or an unrecognized label kept verbatim; never infer a level from school grade or rank.
policy.relationships: Kentei related forms share an attested species ID, not necessarily a glyph or grade. Dictionary candidates require exact form/reading and reading restrictions; they do not classify every sense or authorize a canonical redirect.
policy.canonicalTargets: Only runtime-resolved exact form/reading words and exact kanji records are canonical targets. Null means reference-only, not a dangling link. JMdict candidates are separate, restriction-checked relationships, not asserted sense identity.
policy.wordKanji: Only explicit dict.k, words.k and kotobako containsKanji source relationships. No spelling decomposition, normalized identity, or exam-level inheritance.

census.dictionaryRule: Exact printed form and reading, respecting JMdict readingWrittenScopes. All candidates retained; no sense-level classification or automatic canonical redirect.
census.dictionaryLinkScope: Every attested reading on a classified vocabulary printed key; unassigned words retain runtime targets but are not matched to JMdict here.
census.kankenRelationshipRule: Shared source species_id only. Retain each entry_id, glyph and grade; never inherit metadata or grades across related forms.
